question: Express the speed of 36 km/h in m/s.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To convert **km/h** to **m/s**, multiply the speed by the fraction **5/18**.

Speed in m/s = 36 × (5/18)

Speed in m/s = 2 × 5 = 10 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 10 m/s.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Speed = 36 km/h

**Formula Used:** 1 km = 1000 m and 1 hour = 3600 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dadd7d15430f8e14b8485bae266b8bbce6efeb61f71d5bec637ddfa759593fd.png] 

⇒ Speed = 36 × (1000 m / 3600 s)

⇒ Speed = 36 × (10 / 36) m/s

⇒ Speed = 1 × 10 m/s

⇒ Speed = 10 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 10 m/s.**

**__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion Factor

To convert **m/s** back to **km/h**, multiply by the reciprocal **18/5**.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For two equal distances at speeds a and b, Average Speed = 2ab/(a+b).

Relative Speed

In the same direction, subtract speeds (S₁ − S₂). In opposite directions, add speeds (S₁ + S₂).</p
